name: Camping Heiterwanger See Fischer am See
beschreibung: Camping Heiterwanger See Fischer am See is located directly on the northern shore of Lake Heiterwanger See in the municipality of Heiterwang. The facility provides pitches for motorhomes and caravans as well as rental bungalows with scenic lake views. Sanitary amenities with showers and washing machines are available on site. A kiosk and a cosy restaurant supply guests with food and refreshing dining options. Right by the lake, there is a swimming pier and boat rental services. The surrounding Lechtal valley and Plansee region are a haven for hikers and cyclists.
